_README: GENERATED by orchestration/lib/gen_plan.py — do not hand-edit; regenerate. cmd: python3 orchestration/lib/gen_plan.py lesalondelaphoto --kind build --source-url https://www.lesalondelaphoto.com. 1 story = 1 step; 1 component per story; deterministic steps are task_type=script.
goal: Migrate https://www.lesalondelaphoto.com to Jahia module+site lesalondelaphoto — build phase (module, components, templates, media). Run the generated content plan afterwards.

epics.title: Connect + analyze + extract
epics.goal: Verify Jahia, analyze the captured reference into the component manifest, then deterministically extract media + content.

steps.title: Verify Jahia connection (Gate 0)
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/connect.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Analyze reference -> component manifest (Gate 1: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the namespace provided in inputs (lsp / lspmix) for EVERY nodeType in component-manifest.json — do NOT invent a different prefix.
Content with its own navigable URL (news/blog articles, press releases, events, products) are jmix:mainResource detail content types: needsMainResource:true.
BROWSER-FIRST CAPTURE (anti-hallucination): if the site is JS-rendered or behind a WAF, capture per .agents/skills/capture-reference/SKILL.md — never improvise from the static shell alone.
If the source declares its components in the DOM (e.g. Sitecore SXA .component/field-* markers), extract them deterministically — do not eyeball-discover.
Write ALL 4 outputs: analysis.md, component-manifest.json, content-data.json, asset-inventory.json.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/analyze.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
Gate 1: present section map + field splits, return status halt.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/contract.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto step_analyze
